issues.title: Handle `Message Read` in chat channels
issues.body:
We have a dedicated channel type when the messages are all just chat.

But, since chat messages don't expand/collapse, we don't have an action that marks them as `Read`.  This means the counter goes forever upwards.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/133442634-b9f994fc-70f5-4a59-a795-9e2aaada77d7.png)

## Strategy One
I propose that when a chat channel is open, we treat its messages as read.

So, when we open a chat channel, we mark all messages as read, and the counter goes.  If a new message comes into an open chat channel, we don't increment the counter.  

But, we do increment the counter while a chat channel is collapsed.

## Strategy Two
We include the `Mark all as read` command button like we do in channels where messages to get opened/collapsed.

Then users consciously decide they are up to speed on the channel.
